panels.description: A live paper session exists only when the trading process and its paper experiment both claim to be running and the process heartbeat is fresh. The bot service itself may be healthy while Active Sessions is zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT p.process_id) AS "Active Sessions"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
JOIN polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e
  ON e.process_id=p.process_id
 AND e.status='running'
 AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.enabled
  AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
  AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
  AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes';

SELECT count(DISTINCT p.process_id) AS "Lifecycle Mismatch"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e
  ON e.process_id=p.process_id
 AND e.status='running'
 AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND (
    (
      p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
    ) <> (e.experiment_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR (
      (
        (p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL)
        OR e.experiment_id IS NOT NULL
      )
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)<now()-interval '2 minutes'
    )
  );

SELECT count(*) AS "Failures 24h"
    FROM polymarket.trading_processes
    WHERE process_scope = 'realtime_paper'
      AND status = 'failed'
      AND updated_at >= now()-interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Realtime Process Health

panels.description: Per-process unrealized PnL sampled every 30 seconds for active realtime-paper experiments. A zero means the process has no open positions; a gap means at least one open position lacked a fresh integrity-ok best bid, so no partial total is shown.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts,$__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(date_bin('30 seconds',from_ts,timestamptz '1970-01-01'),to_ts,interval '30 seconds') AS "time" FROM bounds
  UNION SELECT to_ts FROM bounds
), active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.experiment_id,e.process_id,e.name,COALESCE(e.started_at,e.created_at) AS started_at
  FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e
  JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
), process_buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT b."time",a.experiment_id,a.process_id,a.name
  FROM active a JOIN buckets b ON b."time">=a.started_at
), entry_states AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pb."time",pb.experiment_id,pb.process_id,pb.name,o.order_id,o.token_id,
         SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
         SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM process_buckets pb
  JOIN polymarket.orders o ON o.process_id=pb.process_id
    AND o.raw_payload#>>'{request,metadata,experiment_id}'=pb.experiment_id::text
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.source='paper'
    AND f.timestamp_utc<=pb."time"
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=o.market_id
    AND (m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL OR pb."time"<m.official_resolution_received_at)
  GROUP BY pb."time",pb.experiment_id,pb.process_id,pb.name,o.order_id,o.token_id
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid
  FROM entry_states e
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.best_bid FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints c
    WHERE c.token_id=e.token_id AND c.integrity_status='ok' AND c.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND c.source_timestamp BETWEEN e."time"-interval '2 seconds' AND e."time"+interval '1 second'
      AND c.received_at BETWEEN e."time"-interval '2 seconds' AND e."time"
    ORDER BY c.source_timestamp DESC,c.received_at DESC,c.ingest_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
), series AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pb."time",pb.process_id,pb.name,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(m.order_id)=0 THEN 0::numeric
              WHEN COUNT(m.order_id)=COUNT(m.best_bid)
              THEN SUM(m.filled_size*m.best_bid-m.entry_cost-m.entry_fees)
         END AS value
  FROM process_buckets pb
  LEFT JOIN marked m ON m."time"=pb."time" AND m.experiment_id=pb.experiment_id
    AND m.process_id=pb.process_id
  GROUP BY pb."time",pb.experiment_id,pb.process_id,pb.name
)
SELECT "time",name||' ['||left(process_id::text,8)||']' AS metric,
       value::double precision AS value
FROM series ORDER BY "time",metric;

panels.title: Active Fresh Unrealized PnL by Process

panels.description: Cumulative realized PnL for fresh, currently running paper sessions only. Stopped experiments are available in the evidence and history rows below, not in this live row.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts,$__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(date_bin('5 minutes',from_ts,timestamptz '1970-01-01'),to_ts,interval '5 minutes') AS "time" FROM bounds
  UNION SELECT to_ts FROM bounds
), active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*
  FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e
  JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
    AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
), entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.experiment_id,a.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,o.market_id,
         SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
         SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS fees
  FROM active a JOIN polymarket.orders o ON o.process_id=a.process_id
    AND o.raw_payload#>>'{request,metadata,experiment_id}'=a.experiment_id::text
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.source='paper'
  GROUP BY a.experiment_id,a.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,o.market_id
), exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.experiment_id,e.process_id,m.official_resolution_received_at AS realized_at,
         (CASE WHEN e.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost-e.fees)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM entries e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id) CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at<=b.to_ts
)
SELECT b."time",a.name||' ['||left(a.process_id::text,8)||']' AS metric,
       COALESCE(SUM(x.net_pnl) FILTER(WHERE x.realized_at<=b."time"),0)::double precision AS value
FROM active a
JOIN buckets b ON b."time">=COALESCE(a.started_at,a.created_at)
LEFT JOIN exits x ON x.experiment_id=a.experiment_id AND x.process_id=a.process_id
GROUP BY b."time",a.experiment_id,a.name,a.process_id
ORDER BY b."time",metric;

panels.title: Active Cumulative Net Realized PnL

targets.rawSql:
WITH active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.experiment_id,e.process_id
  FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
), open_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM active e JOIN polymarket.orders o ON o.process_id=e.process_id
    AND o.raw_payload#>>'{request,metadata,experiment_id}'=e.experiment_id::text
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.source='paper'
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=o.market_id
  WHERE m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY e.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid,mark.source_timestamp AS mark_at
  FROM open_entries e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.best_bid,c.source_timestamp FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints c
    WHERE c.token_id=e.token_id AND c.integrity_status='ok' AND c.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND c.source_timestamp BETWEEN now()-interval '2 seconds' AND now()+interval '1 second'
      AND c.received_at BETWEEN now()-interval '2 seconds' AND now()
    ORDER BY c.source_timestamp DESC,c.received_at DESC,c.ingest_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
), summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_count,COUNT(best_bid) AS fresh_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(filled_size*best_bid-entry_cost-entry_fees) FILTER(WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL),0) AS value,
         MAX(mark_at) AS latest_mark_at FROM marked
)
SELECT CASE WHEN open_count=0 THEN 0::double precision
            WHEN fresh_count=open_count THEN value::double precision ELSE NULL::double precision END AS "Fresh Unrealized PnL",
       open_count AS "Open Positions",open_count-fresh_count AS "Stale or Unpriced"
FROM summary;

WITH active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.experiment_id FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e
  JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.net_pnl),0)::double precision AS "Active Net Realized PnL"
FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN active USING(experiment_id);

WITH active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,p.name AS process_name,p.process_type,p.process_scope,p.status AS process_status,
         p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at AS process_updated_at
  FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
), open_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM active a JOIN polymarket.orders o ON o.process_id=a.process_id
    AND o.raw_payload#>>'{request,metadata,experiment_id}'=a.experiment_id::text
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.source='paper'
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=o.market_id
  WHERE m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY a.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid,mark.source_timestamp AS mark_at
  FROM open_entries e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.best_bid,c.source_timestamp FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints c
    WHERE c.token_id=e.token_id AND c.integrity_status='ok' AND c.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND c.source_timestamp BETWEEN now()-interval '2 seconds' AND now()+interval '1 second'
      AND c.received_at BETWEEN now()-interval '2 seconds' AND now()
    ORDER BY c.source_timestamp DESC,c.received_at DESC,c.ingest_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
), open_pnl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS open_count,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE best_bid IS NULL) AS stale_or_unpriced,
         MAX(mark_at) AS latest_mark_at,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(best_bid)
              THEN COALESCE(SUM(filled_size*best_bid-entry_cost-entry_fees),0) END AS unrealized_pnl
  FROM marked GROUP BY process_id
), metrics AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.*,COALESCE(o.open_count,0) AS open_positions,COALESCE(o.stale_or_unpriced,0) AS stale_or_unpriced,
         o.latest_mark_at,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.open_count,0)=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE o.unrealized_pnl END AS unrealized_pnl,
         CASE WHEN a.config#>>'{raw,paper,venue,starting_collateral_usd}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN (a.config#>>'{raw,paper,venue,starting_collateral_usd}')::numeric END AS roi_denominator
  FROM active a LEFT JOIN open_pnl o USING(process_id)
)
SELECT process_name,process_type,process_scope,
       COALESCE(config#>>'{execution,mode}','unknown') AS execution_mode,process_status AS status,
       heartbeat_at AS last_heartbeat,EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()-COALESCE(heartbeat_at,process_updated_at))::bigint AS heartbeat_age_seconds,
       GREATEST(process_updated_at,updated_at,COALESCE(latest_mark_at,updated_at)) AS last_updated,
       markets_observed,snapshots_recorded,decisions_recorded,trades_entered,trades_resolved,
       open_positions,stale_or_unpriced,latest_mark_at,
       gross_pnl::double precision,fees_paid::double precision,net_pnl::double precision AS realized_pnl,
       unrealized_pnl::double precision,(net_pnl+unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS total_pnl,
       CASE WHEN roi_denominator>0 THEN ((net_pnl+unrealized_pnl)/roi_denominator)::double precision END AS roi
FROM metrics ORDER BY last_updated DESC,process_name;

panels.title: Active Process PnL and Runtime Stats

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,p.name AS process_name,p.status AS process_status,p.enabled,p.heartbeat_at,
         p.stopped_at AS process_stopped_at,p.last_error
  FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                 AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
                 AND p.stopped_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
                THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), windows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT m.* FROM target t
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id,market_id FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions) d USING(experiment_id)
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
  WHERE m.window_start>=t.started_at AND m.window_end<=COALESCE(t.stopped_at,now())
)
SELECT t.name,t.process_status,t.started_at,t.stopped_at,
       EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(t.stopped_at,now())-t.started_at)/3600 AS runtime_hours,
       COUNT(w.market_id) AS complete_windows,
       COUNT(w.market_id) FILTER(WHERE w.official_outcome IS NOT NULL) AS resolved_windows,
       COUNT(w.market_id) FILTER(WHERE w.official_resolution_received_at<=w.window_end+interval '120 seconds') AS resolved_within_slo,
       100.0*COUNT(w.market_id) FILTER(WHERE w.official_resolution_received_at<=w.window_end+interval '120 seconds')/NULLIF(COUNT(w.market_id),0) AS resolution_slo_pct,
       t.snapshots_recorded,t.decisions_recorded,t.trades_entered,t.trades_resolved,
       t.gross_pnl::double precision,t.fees_paid::double precision,t.net_pnl::double precision,
       (t.net_pnl/NULLIF(t.trades_resolved,0))::double precision AS net_per_resolved_trade,
       NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,available_collateral_usd}','')::double precision AS available_collateral_usd,
       NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,entry_debits_usd}','')::double precision AS cumulative_entry_debits_usd,
       NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,settlement_credits_usd}','')::double precision AS cumulative_payouts_usd,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,ledger,settlements_credited}','')::bigint,0) AS settlements_credited,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,ledger,settlements_pending}','')::bigint,0) AS settlements_pending,
       GREATEST(t.trades_entered-COALESCE(NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,ledger,settlements_credited}','')::bigint,0),0) AS unsettled_filled_orders,
       NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,reconciled_at}','')::timestamptz AS capital_reconciled_at,
       t.config_hash,t.stop_reason,t.last_error
FROM target t LEFT JOIN windows w ON true
GROUP BY t.experiment_id,t.name,t.process_status,t.started_at,t.stopped_at,t.snapshots_recorded,
         t.decisions_recorded,t.trades_entered,t.trades_resolved,t.gross_pnl,t.fees_paid,t.net_pnl,
         t.summary,t.config_hash,t.stop_reason,t.last_error;

matcher.options: /^(Available Collateral|Cumulative Payouts|Collateral Reconciliation Gap|Entry Debit Reconciliation Gap|Payout Reconciliation Gap|PnL Reconciliation Gap)$/
/^(Non-paper Fill Rows|Pending Settlement Credits|Collateral Reconciliation Gap|Entry Debit Reconciliation Gap|Payout Reconciliation Gap|Settlement Count Gap|PnL Reconciliation Gap)$/

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.* FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), windows AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM target t
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id,market_id FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions) d USING(experiment_id)
 JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
 WHERE m.window_start>=t.started_at AND m.window_end<=COALESCE(t.stopped_at,now())
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Complete Windows",COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE official_outcome IS NOT NULL) AS "Official Resolved",
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE official_resolution_received_at<=window_end+interval '120 seconds') AS "Within 120s",
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE official_outcome IS NOT NULL AND official_resolution_received_at>window_end+interval '120 seconds') AS "Late",
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE official_outcome IS NULL AND now()>window_end+interval '120 seconds') AS "Overdue",
 ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE official_resolution_received_at<=window_end+interval '120 seconds')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS "Resolution SLO %"
FROM windows;

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.*
 FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), decision_stats AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.order_plan_id IS NOT NULL) AS plans,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.action='buy' AND d.status='filled') AS filled,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.action='buy' AND d.status='rejected') AS rejected
 FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d JOIN target USING(experiment_id)
), experiment_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.* FROM polymarket.orders o JOIN target t
   ON o.raw_payload#>>'{request,metadata,experiment_id}'=t.experiment_id::text
), fill_stats AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.source='paper') AS paper_fill_rows,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.source<>'paper') AS nonpaper_fill_rows,
        COALESCE(SUM(f.fee) FILTER(WHERE f.source='paper'),0)::numeric AS fees,
        COALESCE(SUM(f.price*f.size) FILTER(WHERE f.source='paper'),0)::numeric AS notional
 FROM experiment_orders o LEFT JOIN polymarket.fills f USING(order_id)
), ledger_stats AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS discovered,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE l.credit_status='credited') AS credited,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE l.credit_status='pending') AS pending,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.payout) FILTER(WHERE l.credit_status='credited'),0)::numeric AS payout_credited,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.net_pnl),0)::numeric AS ledger_net_pnl
 FROM polymarket.btc_paper_settlement_ledger l JOIN target USING(experiment_id)
), capital AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,starting_collateral_usd}','')::numeric AS starting_collateral,
        NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,available_collateral_usd}','')::numeric AS available_collateral,
        NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,entry_debits_usd}','')::numeric AS entry_debits,
        NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,settlement_credits_usd}','')::numeric AS settlement_credits,
        NULLIF(t.summary#>>'{paper_capital,venue,settlements_applied}','')::bigint AS settlements_applied,
        t.net_pnl::numeric AS experiment_net_pnl
 FROM target t
)
SELECT d.plans AS "Order Plans",d.filled AS "Filled Plans",d.rejected AS "Rejected Plans",
 ROUND(100.0*d.filled/NULLIF(d.plans,0),2) AS "Paper Fill Rate %",
 f.paper_fill_rows AS "Paper Fill Rows",f.nonpaper_fill_rows AS "Non-paper Fill Rows",
 c.available_collateral::double precision AS "Available Collateral",
 c.settlement_credits::double precision AS "Cumulative Payouts",
 GREATEST(d.filled-l.credited,0) AS "Unsettled Filled Orders",l.pending AS "Pending Settlement Credits",
 ABS(c.available_collateral-(c.starting_collateral-c.entry_debits+c.settlement_credits))::double precision AS "Collateral Reconciliation Gap",
 ABS(c.entry_debits-(f.notional+f.fees))::double precision AS "Entry Debit Reconciliation Gap",
 ABS(c.settlement_credits-l.payout_credited)::double precision AS "Payout Reconciliation Gap",
 ABS(c.settlements_applied-l.credited)::bigint AS "Settlement Count Gap",
 ABS(c.experiment_net_pnl-l.ledger_net_pnl)::double precision AS "PnL Reconciliation Gap"
FROM decision_stats d CROSS JOIN fill_stats f CROSS JOIN ledger_stats l CROSS JOIN capital c;

panels.title: Paper Execution, Capital, and Settlement Safety

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.* FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), windows AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM target t
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id,market_id FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions) d USING(experiment_id)
 JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
 WHERE m.window_start>=t.started_at AND m.window_end<=COALESCE(t.stopped_at,now())
)
SELECT COUNT(w.market_id) FILTER(WHERE w.official_outcome IS NOT NULL) AS "Resolved Windows",
       2000::bigint AS "Window Target",
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(w.market_id) FILTER(WHERE w.official_outcome IS NOT NULL)/2000,2) AS "Window Progress %",
       MAX(t.trades_resolved) AS "Resolved Trades",100::bigint AS "Trade Target",
       ROUND(100.0*MAX(t.trades_resolved)/100,2) AS "Trade Progress %"
FROM target t LEFT JOIN windows w ON true;

SELECT e.name,e.strategy_version,e.status,p.status AS process_status,e.started_at,e.stopped_at,
 ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(e.stopped_at,now())-e.started_at)/3600)::numeric,2) AS runtime_hours,
 w.complete_windows,w.resolved_windows,w.within_slo,e.snapshots_recorded,e.decisions_recorded,
 e.trades_entered,e.trades_resolved,e.gross_pnl::double precision,e.fees_paid::double precision,
 e.net_pnl::double precision,(e.net_pnl/NULLIF(e.trades_resolved,0))::double precision AS net_per_trade,
 e.stop_reason,p.last_error,left(e.config_hash,12) AS config_hash
FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS complete_windows,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL) AS resolved_windows,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE m.official_resolution_received_at<=m.window_end+interval '120 seconds') AS within_slo
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT market_id FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions WHERE experiment_id=e.experiment_id) d
 JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
 WHERE m.window_start>=e.started_at AND m.window_end<=COALESCE(e.stopped_at,now())
) w ON true
WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper' ORDER BY e.started_at DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Market Data, Decisions, and ML Shadow

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.experiment_id FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric n FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d JOIN target USING(experiment_id)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN d.action='buy' AND d.status='filled' THEN 'filled'
            WHEN d.action='buy' THEN COALESCE(d.reject_reason,'buy_rejected')
            ELSE COALESCE(d.reject_reason,'no_trade') END AS reason,
       COUNT(*) AS decisions,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/NULLIF(MAX(totals.n),0),2) AS pct_of_decisions,
       MAX(d.decision_at) AS latest_at
FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d JOIN target USING(experiment_id) CROSS JOIN totals
GROUP BY reason ORDER BY decisions DESC;

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.experiment_id,e.stopped_at,
        CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                  AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                  AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_active
 FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT d.decision_at,s.* FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d JOIN target USING(experiment_id)
 JOIN polymarket.btc_feature_snapshots s USING(snapshot_id) ORDER BY d.decision_at DESC LIMIT 1
), recent AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE s.readiness_status='ready') AS ready
 FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d JOIN target t USING(experiment_id)
 JOIN polymarket.btc_feature_snapshots s USING(snapshot_id)
 WHERE d.decision_at>=COALESCE(t.stopped_at,now())-interval '15 minutes'
)
SELECT l.decision_at,l.readiness_status,l.chainlink_age_ms,l.binance_age_ms,l.book_age_ms,l.source_skew_ms,
       CASE WHEN t.is_active THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()-l.received_at)*1000) END AS live_snapshot_age_ms,
       ROUND(100.0*r.ready/NULLIF(r.total,0),2) AS "Ready % Last 15m",
       l.quality_flags#>'{quality_flags}' AS quality_flags
FROM latest l CROSS JOIN target t CROSS JOIN recent r;

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.started_at,COALESCE(e.stopped_at,now()) AS ended_at
 FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.*,LAG(s.disconnected_at) OVER(PARTITION BY s.feed_name ORDER BY s.started_at) AS previous_disconnect
 FROM polymarket.feed_sessions s CROSS JOIN target t
 WHERE s.started_at<t.ended_at AND COALESCE(s.disconnected_at,t.ended_at)>=t.started_at
)
SELECT feed_name,COUNT(*) AS sessions,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE disconnect_reason IS NOT NULL AND disconnect_reason NOT IN ('market_watch_changed','shutdown')) AS abnormal_disconnects,
 ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(epoch FROM started_at-previous_disconnect)) FILTER(WHERE started_at>previous_disconnect)::numeric,2) AS max_reconnect_gap_s,
 SUM(messages_received) AS messages_received,SUM(messages_persisted) AS messages_persisted,
 SUM(decode_errors) AS decode_errors,SUM(integrity_gaps) AS integrity_gaps,
 SUM(dropped_messages) AS dropped_messages,MAX(disconnected_at) AS latest_disconnected_at
FROM sessions GROUP BY feed_name ORDER BY feed_name;

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.summary,e.config AS experiment_config FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e
 JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id) WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,enqueued}')::bigint,0) AS enqueued,
 COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,completed}')::bigint,0) AS completed,
 COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,queue_depth}')::bigint,0) AS queue_depth,
 COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,queue_high_water}')::bigint,0) AS high_water,
 COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,rejected_full}')::bigint,0) AS rejected_full,
 COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,rejected_closed}')::bigint,0) AS rejected_closed,
 COALESCE((summary#>>'{ml_shadow_runtime,tasks_failed}')::bigint,0) AS tasks_failed,
 COALESCE((experiment_config#>>'{raw,ml_shadow,execution_authority}')::boolean,false) AS execution_authority
FROM target;

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.experiment_id FROM polymarket.btc_paper_experiments e JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p USING(process_id)
 WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.status='running' AND e.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
                    AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
), snapshots AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT d.snapshot_id FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d JOIN target USING(experiment_id)
), vectors AS (
 SELECT v.task,COUNT(*) AS vectors FROM polymarket.ml_feature_vectors v JOIN snapshots USING(snapshot_id) GROUP BY v.task
), predictions AS (
 SELECT p.task,COUNT(*) AS predictions,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.status<>'predicted') AS failed,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.metadata->>'schema_canary'='true') AS canary,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.metadata->>'influenced_order_plan'='true') AS influenced,
        AVG(p.inference_latency_us) AS avg_latency_us,MAX(p.inference_latency_us) AS max_latency_us
 FROM polymarket.ml_shadow_predictions p JOIN snapshots USING(snapshot_id) GROUP BY p.task
)
SELECT COALESCE(v.task,p.task) AS task,COALESCE(v.vectors,0) AS vectors,COALESCE(p.predictions,0) AS predictions,
 ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(p.predictions,0)/NULLIF(v.vectors,0),2) AS "Coverage %",
 COALESCE(p.failed,0) AS failed,COALESCE(p.canary,0) AS canary,
 COALESCE(p.influenced,0) AS influenced_orders,ROUND(p.avg_latency_us,2) AS avg_latency_us,p.max_latency_us
FROM vectors v FULL JOIN predictions p USING(task) ORDER BY task;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Completed Backtests"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes
WHERE process_scope = 'backtest'
  AND status = 'completed';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Failed Backtests"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes
WHERE process_scope = 'backtest'
  AND status = 'failed';

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '15 minutes') AS "time"
  UNION
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS "time"
), positions AS (
  SELECT
    tp.position_id,
    tp.process_id,
    tp.entry_timestamp
  FROM polymarket.trade_positions tp
  JOIN polymarket.trading_processes proc
    ON proc.process_id = tp.process_id
  WHERE tp.status IN ('open', 'partially_closed')
    AND tp.open_size > 0
    AND tp.process_id IS NOT NULL
    AND proc.process_scope = 'backtest'
), position_marks AS (
  SELECT
    b."time",
    p.process_id,
    latest_mark.net_unrealized_pnl
  FROM buckets b
  JOIN positions p
    ON p.entry_timestamp <= b."time"
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m.net_unrealized_pnl
    FROM polymarket.trade_marks m
    WHERE m.position_id = p.position_id
      AND m.timestamp_utc <= b."time"
      AND m.timestamp_utc >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '48 hours'
    ORDER BY m.timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest_mark ON true
)
SELECT
  "time",
  left(process_id::text, 8) AS metric,
  SUM(net_unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS value
FROM position_marks
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '15 minutes') AS "time"
  UNION
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS "time"
), exit_events AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(e.process_id, tp.process_id) AS process_id,
    e.timestamp_utc,
    e.net_pnl
  FROM polymarket.trade_exits e
  JOIN polymarket.trade_positions tp
    ON tp.position_id = e.position_id
  JOIN polymarket.trading_processes proc
    ON proc.process_id = COALESCE(e.process_id, tp.process_id)
  WHERE NOT e.is_synthetic
    AND COALESCE(e.process_id, tp.process_id) IS NOT NULL
    AND e.timestamp_utc <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND proc.process_scope = 'backtest'
), processes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT process_id
  FROM exit_events
)
SELECT
  b."time",
  left(p.process_id::text, 8) AS metric,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.net_pnl), 0)::double precision AS value
FROM processes p
CROSS JOIN buckets b
LEFT JOIN exit_events e
  ON e.process_id = p.process_id
 AND e.timestamp_utc <= b."time"
GROUP BY b."time", p.process_id
ORDER BY b."time", metric;

panels.title: Backtest Cumulative Realized PnL by Process

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(tp.unrealized_pnl) FILTER (WHERE tp.status IN ('open', 'partially_closed')), 0)::double precision AS "Backtest Total Unrealized PnL"
FROM polymarket.trade_positions tp
JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p
  ON p.process_id = tp.process_id
WHERE tp.process_id IS NOT NULL
  AND p.process_scope = 'backtest';

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(tp.realized_pnl), 0)::double precision AS "Backtest Total Realized PnL"
FROM polymarket.trade_positions tp
JOIN polymarket.trading_processes p
  ON p.process_id = tp.process_id
WHERE tp.process_id IS NOT NULL
  AND p.process_scope = 'backtest';

WITH position_pnl AS (
  SELECT
    process_id,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_position_updated,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('open', 'partially_closed')) AS open_positions,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('closed', 'resolved') AND realized_pnl > 0) AS winning_closed_positions,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('closed', 'resolved') AND realized_pnl < 0) AS losing_closed_positions,
    COALESCE(SUM(unrealized_pnl) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('open', 'partially_closed')), 0) AS unrealized_pnl,
    COALESCE(SUM(realized_pnl), 0) AS realized_pnl,
    COALESCE(SUM(entry_notional), 0) AS entry_notional
  FROM polymarket.trade_positions
  WHERE process_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY process_id
)
SELECT
  p.name AS process_name,
  GREATEST(p.updated_at, COALESCE(position_pnl.last_position_updated, p.updated_at)) AS last_updated,
  COALESCE(position_pnl.open_positions, 0)::integer AS open_positions,
  COALESCE(position_pnl.winning_closed_positions, 0)::integer AS winning_closed_positions,
  COALESCE(position_pnl.losing_closed_positions, 0)::integer AS losing_closed_positions,
  COALESCE(position_pnl.unrealized_pnl, 0)::double precision AS unrealized_pnl,
  COALESCE(position_pnl.realized_pnl, 0)::double precision AS realized_pnl,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(position_pnl.entry_notional, 0) > 0
      THEN ((COALESCE(position_pnl.realized_pnl, 0) + COALESCE(position_pnl.unrealized_pnl, 0)) / position_pnl.entry_notional)::double precision
    ELSE 0::double precision
  END AS roi
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
LEFT JOIN position_pnl
  ON position_pnl.process_id = p.process_id
WHERE p.process_scope = 'backtest'
ORDER BY last_updated DESC, p.name;
